kinds.fixed: Always the same spell(s); PF2e does not add them to the actor.
kinds.granted: PF2e already adds the spell item itself via a GrantItem rule (module only has to move it into a focus entry). No focus spell in 8.2.0 has this: see grantItemSpellsInPf2e.
kinds.choice: Determined by an earlier choice: choice.type 'feature' = slug of an owned feature carrying choice.tag, 'flag' = flags.pf2e.rulesSelections.<flag> on THIS item (value = domain slug), 'flagOfFeat' = that flag on the owned feat 'feat'. choice.map (or the shared `domains` table) maps the selection to spell UUIDs.
kinds.pick: The player picks at grant time from pick.options / pick.map / pick.from ('domains' = see `domains`, 'features' = owned feature tag).

_meta.traditionValues: arcane|divine|occult|primal = fixed; 'class' = the class's own spellcasting tradition; 'bloodline' = the owned sorcerer bloodline's tradition; 'choice' = chosen with the first spell (monk: divine or occult); null = not stated.
_meta.abilityValues: str|dex|con|int|wis|cha = fixed; 'class' = the class's own spellcasting attribute; null = not stated.

confidence.curated: hand-written entry whose source sentence is regex-checked
confidence.heuristic: sentence match 'You gain/learn the X focus spell'; review before trusting

_meta.focusPoolEngine: CharacterPF2e.prepareBaseData sets resources.focus {max: 0, cap: 3}; SpellPF2e.prepareActorData adds +1 to resources.focus.max for every owned spell with the 'focus' trait and not the 'cantrip' trait (location irrelevant); CreaturePF2e then clamps max to 0..3. A few features add to it with ActiveEffectLike (focusPoolRuleElements).
coverageGaps: wizard elemental school (spells not enumerated in the item)
archetype 'domain' feats with bespoke domain lists (bright-lion, rose-warden, steel-falcon, godling, rivethun, ...) are heuristic picks, not mapped to the domain table
mythic / adventure-path archetypes not scanned for hidden prose (only feats + class-features packs were)

Committing wanton cruelty to plants or fungi or neglecting to nurture plants in need of tending is anathema to your order. This doesn't prevent you from killing plants or fungi and it doesn't prevent you from defending yourself against plants or fungi.
sourceQuotes.spore-order: You're trained in Intimidation. You also gain the Leshy Familiar druid feat, but you must create a fungus leshy. You gain the mushroom patch order spell. This doesn't prevent you from defending yourself against fungi or molds or from harvesting fungi or molds for sustenance.

manifold-conduit.name: Manifold Conduit
manifold-conduit.note: You gain the Entreat the Many focus spell.

mantis-form.name: Mantis Form
mantis-form.note: You gain the Mantis Form focus spell.

master-of-the-dead.name: Master of the Dead
master-of-the-dead.note: You learn the Shambling Horror focus spell.

master-qi-spells.name: Master Qi Spells
master-qi-spells.note: You gain Medusa's Wrath, Touch of Death, or another 8th-rank qi spell you have access to.

masterful-warden.name: Masterful Warden
masterful-warden.note: Your mastery of warden magic increases. You gain your choice of one warden spell from the master warden spells.

nights-glow.name: Night's Glow
nights-glow.note: You gain your choice of the Moonbeam or Zenith Star domain spell.

nights-shine.name: Night's Shine
nights-shine.note: You gain your choice of the Asterism or Touch of the Moon domain spell.

ode-to-ouroboros.name: Ode to Ouroboros
ode-to-ouroboros.note: You learn the Ode to Ouroboros composition spell, which enables you to temporarily spare your allies from death.

order-magic.name: Order Magic

pick.note: An order chosen with Order Explorer (not the druid's own order).

order-magic.note: You gain the initial order spell from that order.

order-spell.name: Order Spell
order-spell.note: You gain the initial order spell from your order.

patron.name: Patron

sourceQuotes.baba-yaga: You gain the Spirit Object hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.choir-politic: You gain the Share Vision hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.cobyslarni: You gain the Information Overload hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.devourer-of-decay: You gain the Scrounger's Glee hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.faiths-flamekeeper: You gain the Stoke the Heart hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.mosquito-witch: You gain the Buzzing Bites hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.paradox-of-opposites: You gain the Trade Death for Life hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.ripple-in-the-deep: You gain the Sting of the Sea hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.silence-in-snow: You learn the Clinging Ice hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.spinner-of-threads: You gain the Nudge Fate hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.starless-shadow: You gain the Shroud of Night hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.the-inscribed-one: You gain the Discern Secrets hex
sourceQuotes.the-resentment: You gain the Evil Eye hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.the-unseen-broker: You gain the Pact Broker hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.whisper-of-wings: You gain the Murmuration hex cantrip
sourceQuotes.wilding-steward: You gain the Wilding Word hex cantrip

choice.note: Hex cantrip from the patron's first lesson (a focus cantrip: no Focus Point).

patron.note: At 1st level, choose your patron, which determines your spellcasting tradition and grants you the skill for that tradition of magic, your first witch's lesson and a unique familiar ability.

peerless-warden.name: Peerless Warden
peerless-warden.note: Your mastery of primal magic has given you access to the greatest secrets of warden magic. You gain your choice of one warden spell from the peerless warden spells.

perfect-ki-adept.name: Perfect Ki Adept
perfect-ki-adept.note: You gain the appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: Unblinking Flame Revelation for Unblinking Flame, Unbreaking Wave Advance for Unbreaking Waves, Unfolding Wind Rush for Unfolding Wind, or Untwisting Iron Buffer for Untwisting Iron.

perfect-ki-exemplar.name: Perfect Ki Exemplar
perfect-ki-exemplar.note: You gain an appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: Unblinking Flame Emblem for Unblinking Flame, Unbreaking Wave Barrier for Unbreaking Waves, Unfolding Wind Blitz for Unfolding Wind, or Untwisting Iron Augmentation for Untwisting Iron.

perfect-ki-expert.name: Perfect Ki Expert
perfect-ki-expert.note: You gain an appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: Unblinking Flame Aura for Unblinking Flame, Unbreaking Wave Vapor for Unbreaking Waves, Unfolding Wind Buffet for Unfolding Wind, or Untwisting Iron Roots for Untwisting Iron.

perfect-ki-grandmaster.name: Perfect Ki Grandmaster
perfect-ki-grandmaster.note: You gain an appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: Unblinking Flame Ignition for Unblinking Flame, Unbreaking Wave Containment for Unbreaking Waves, Unfolding Wind Crash for Unfolding Wind, or Untwisting Iron Pillar for Untwisting Iron.

perfect-strike.name: Perfect Strike
perfect-strike.note: You gain the Perfect Strike ki spell.

pied-piping.name: Pied Piping
pied-piping.note: You learn the Pied Piping composition spell, which enables you to control the actions of weak-minded individuals.

positive-luminance.name: Positive Luminance
positive-luminance.note: You gain the domain spell Vital Luminance.

pride.name: Pride
pride.requires: runelord class archetype (School of Thassilonian Rune Magic)

primal-guardian.name: Primal Guardian
primal-guardian.note: You learn either the Elemental Sheath or Vicious Howl focus spell.

primal-summons.name: Primal Summons
primal-summons.note: You gain the Primal Summons order spell.

qi-spells.name: Qi Spells

filter.note: or another 1st-rank monk qi spell you have access to

qi-spells.note: You gain Inner Upheaval, Qi Rush, or another 1st-rank monk qi spell you have access to.

rallying-anthem.name: Rallying Anthem
rallying-anthem.note: You learn the Rallying Anthem composition cantrip, which protects you and allies.

rangers-bramble.name: Ranger's Bramble
rangers-bramble.note: You gain the Ranger's Bramble warden spell.

reinforce-eidolon.name: Reinforce Eidolon
reinforce-eidolon.note: You gain the Reinforce Eidolon link cantrip.

revelation-spells.name: Revelation Spells

sourceQuotes.ancestors: Revelation Spells initial: Ancestral Touch advanced: Ancestral Defense greater: Ancestral Form
sourceQuotes.ashes: Revelation Spells initial: Ashen Wind advanced: Incendiary Ashes greater: Ash Form
sourceQuotes.battle: Revelation Spells initial: Weapon Trance advanced: Battlefield Persistence greater: Revel in Retribution
sourceQuotes.blight: Revelation Spells initial: Ulcerous Canker advanced: Purging Toxins greater: Accelerated Decomposition
sourceQuotes.bones: Revelation Spells initial: Soul Siphon advanced: Armor of Bones greater: Claim Undead
sourceQuotes.cosmos: Revelation Spells initial: Spray of Stars advanced: Interstellar Void greater: Moonlight Bridge
sourceQuotes.flames: Revelation Spells initial: Incendiary Aura advanced: Whirling Flames greater: Flaming Fusillade
sourceQuotes.life: Revelation Spells initial: Life Link advanced: Delay Affliction greater: Life-Giving Form
sourceQuotes.lore: Revelation Spells initial: Brain Drain advanced: Access Lore greater: Dread Secret
sourceQuotes.tempest: Revelation Spells initial: Tempest Touch advanced: Thunderburst greater: Tempest Form
sourceQuotes.time: Revelation Spells initial: Temporal Distortion advanced: Time Skip greater: Manifold Lives

revelation-spells.note: You learn a revelation spell at 1st level and start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

rites-of-liberation.name: Rites of Liberation
rites-of-liberation.note: Additionally, you gain the Unimpeded Stride and Word of Freedom domain spells.

rivethun-emissary-dedication.name: Rivethun Emissary Dedication
rivethun-emissary-dedication.note: You also gain the activity and the Entreat Spirit focus spell.

runic-impression.name: Runic Impression
runic-impression.note: You learn the Runic Impression conflux spell.

seneschal.name: Seneschal
seneschal.note: Adjustments: Instead of your patron's lesson, you gain the Manifest Will hex cantrip and your familiar learns one common 1st-rank spell of your choice from your spell list.

shadow-illusion.name: Shadow Illusion
shadow-illusion.note: You gain the Shadow Illusion focus spell.

shadow-magic.name: Shadow Magic
shadow-magic.note: You learn a shadowdancer focus spell of your choice: Dance of Darkness or Shadow Jump.

shadowcaster-dedication.name: Shadowcaster Dedication
shadowcaster-dedication.note: You gain the Cloak of Shadow domain spell.

shadows-web.name: Shadow's Web
shadows-web.note: You gain the Shadow's Web qi spell.

shall-not-falter-shall-not-rout.name: Shall not Falter, Shall not Rout
shall-not-falter-shall-not-rout.note: You gain the Shall not Falter, Shall not Rout focus spell.

shielding-formation.name: Shielding Formation
shielding-formation.note: You gain the Shielding Formation focus spell.

silvers-refrain.name: Silver's Refrain
silvers-refrain.note: You learn the Silver's Refrain composition cantrip, which aids you when fighting devils.

sloth.name: Sloth
sloth.requires: runelord class archetype (School of Thassilonian Rune Magic)

snare-hopping.name: Snare Hopping
snare-hopping.note: You gain the Snare Hopping warden spell.

song-of-marching.name: Song of Marching
song-of-marching.note: You learn the Song of Marching composition cantrip, which enables you and your allies to cross vast distances without strain.

song-of-strength.name: Song of Strength
song-of-strength.note: You learn the Song of Strength composition cantrip.

song-of-the-fallen.name: Song of the Fallen
song-of-the-fallen.note: You learn the Song of the Fallen composition spell.

songbirds-call.name: Songbird's Call
songbirds-call.note: You learn the Songbird's Call composition spell.

soothing-ballad.name: Soothing Ballad
soothing-ballad.note: You learn the Soothing Ballad composition spell.

speaking-sky.name: Speaking Sky
speaking-sky.note: You gain the Speaking Sky ki spell.

special-sentinel-technique.name: Special Sentinel Technique
special-sentinel-technique.note: You gain either the Luminous Stardust Healing or Shining Starlight Attack focus spell, which you can cast only in sentinel form.

spectral-advance.name: Spectral Advance
spectral-advance.note: You gain the Spectral Advance devotion spell, which lets you move to an enemy, bypassing hindrances.

spellmasters-ward.name: Spellmaster's Ward
spellmasters-ward.note: You gain the Spellmaster's Ward focus spell.

spirit-of-the-beast.name: Spirit of the Beast
spirit-of-the-beast.note: You gain the Spirit of the Beast focus spell.

steal-the-sky.name: Steal the Sky
steal-the-sky.note: You gain the Steal the Sky ki spell.

sun-blade.name: Sun Blade
sun-blade.note: You gain the Sun Blade devotion spell.

suns-fury.name: Sun's Fury
suns-fury.note: You gain the Sun's Fury focus spell.

symphony-of-the-unfettered-heart.name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart
symphony-of-the-unfettered-heart.note: You learn the Symphony of the Unfettered Heart composition spell, which enables you to protect an ally against incapacitating conditions.

time-mage-dedication.name: Time Mage Dedication
time-mage-dedication.note: As some of your future knowledge leaks back to your present self, you gain the Delay Consequence domain spell.

transcribe-moment.name: Transcribe Moment
transcribe-moment.note: You gain the Transcribe Moment focus spell.

triple-time.name: Triple Time
triple-time.note: You learn the Triple Time composition cantrip, which speeds up you and your allies for a round.

unending-emptiness.name: Unending Emptiness
unending-emptiness.note: You gain the Darklight domain spell.

unfetter-eidolon.name: Unfetter Eidolon
unfetter-eidolon.note: You learn the Unfetter Eidolon link spell.

untamed-form.name: Untamed Form
untamed-form.note: You gain the Untamed Form order spell, which lets you transform into a variety of shapes that you can expand with druid feats.

uplifting-overture.name: Uplifting Overture
uplifting-overture.note: You learn the Uplifting Overture composition cantrip, which aids your allies' skills with the inspiring nature of your performance.

vengeful-oath.name: Vengeful Oath
vengeful-oath.note: You gain the following edict: "You must hunt down and exterminate creatures that have committed heinous atrocities." You can use Lay on Hands to damage a creature you witness harming an innocent or a ally as if it were undead; in this case, lay on hands deals spirit damage instead of vitality damage and gains the holy trait.

vindicator.name: Vindicator
vindicator.note: You gain the Vindicator's Mark warden spell.

vindicators-judgment.name: Vindicator's Judgment
vindicators-judgment.note: You gain the Vindicator's Judgment focus spell.

waking-dream.name: Waking Dream
waking-dream.note: You gain the Waking Dream focus spell, which you can use only while you're in a .

wild-winds-initiate.name: Wild Winds Initiate
wild-winds-initiate.note: You gain the Wild Winds Stance qi spell.

wildspell-dedication.name: Wildspell Dedication
wildspell-dedication.note: You gain the Spellsurge focus spell.

wind-caller.name: Wind Caller
wind-caller.note: You gain the Stormwind Flight order spell.

wind-jump.name: Wind Jump
wind-jump.note: You gain the Wind Jump qi spell.

wings-of-the-dragon.name: Wings of the Dragon
wings-of-the-dragon.note: You gain the Dragon Wings sorcerer bloodline spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

wrath.name: Wrath
wrath.requires: runelord class archetype (School of Thassilonian Rune Magic)

wronged-monks-wrath.name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
wronged-monks-wrath.note: You gain the Wronged Monk's Wrath ki spell.

wyldsinger.name: Wyldsinger
wyldsinger.note: You learn either the Menacing Lament or Valiant Anthem focus spell.
